# Python

`.helmsman/tools/python/check.sh` runs `uv lock --check`, `ruff`, `ty` when the project names it, and `pytest` when tests are tracked. A project ruff config stays. Ceilings in `.helmsman/tools/python/ruff.toml` are a floor: complexity 10, arguments 6, statements 50. A higher number fails. A lower number stays. This gate does not start Postgres.
